html:
Perks › Legendary

The Equalizer

Legendary perk · Score multiplier

When you trail by at least 30 points, your scoring plays are doubled.

In-game card text

How it works

While you are 30 or more points behind Rival (before the play), your scoring plays are doubled for each copy.

  • It doubles the whole play: open ends, bonuses and any Golden Double doubling. Maluses are applied after it.

At a glance

RarityLegendary
TypeScore multiplier
Needs a scoring playYes. It only fires when the open-end total is a positive multiple of 5.
How to get itComplete its three career trials (Win 3 matches; Lose 3 matches; Earn 1,000 points), then unlock it for 1,500 Bone Bucks.
